entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: Hawkish ECB remarks are the euro impulse, and the already-printed short-base breakouts in AUDCAD and AUDNZD are the Australian impulse. Oil is not the catalyst.
entry_lifecycle.realization_logic: The long is realized if EURAUD holds the long-base breakout and extends while AUD remains the offered leg on AUDCAD and AUDNZD.

entry_rationale: EURAUD isolates hawkish ECB communication against an Australian dollar that is already offered on AUDCAD and AUDNZD, and it leaves the oil-sensitive Canadian dollar and the yen out of the expression.
entry_thesis: Buy 10 million EURAUD. The clean non-dollar wedge is hawkish ECB commentary against an Australian dollar that is already breaking down versus Canada and New Zealand, and firm oil is a reason to leave AUDCAD alone rather than a reason to own this cross. EURGBP is through the old 0.8331 invalidation, so that ticket stays closed.

events.rationale: EURAUD isolates hawkish ECB communication against an Australian dollar that is already offered on AUDCAD and AUDNZD, and it leaves the oil-sensitive Canadian dollar and the yen out of the expression.

invalidation: Flip the long if ECB communication walks back the hawkish inflation remarks, if AUDCAD and AUDNZD stop showing the Australian dollar as the offered leg, or if EURAUD fails the long-base breakout.
